messages:
alex: heads-up — deploybot scheduled the tenant_id-type-change migration for 21:00 UTC in the migration window. I see a lease collision with a shadow-index job.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Attempting to acquire migration lease for migration: tenant_id-type-change v3. lease_id=lb-8f3e. TTL=900s.
maria: which shadow-index job? link: https://ci/redwood/jobs/idx-shadow-472
sre_jordan: that job is on a different shard group but it holds a cross-shard lease token; we've seen collisions if windows overlap. recommend either stagger by 10m or manual tie-break. :thinking_face:
kim_db: quick context: the tenant_id migration needs a brief quiesce on writes to users table for pk swap. Shadow index is an async index build that can be paused without data-loss.
alex: ops preference is to keep the migration on schedule because it's a hotfix for customer A; can we pause the index?
maria: index job is mid-build at 60%. Pausing will require cancel+resume; estimated extra 25m restart cost.
sre_jordan: we should avoid cancel if possible. Alternative: use deploybot lease tiebreaker flag to prefer migration jobs for production hotfixes.
kim_db: is there a safe fallback if the migration loses lease mid-backfill? We can abort safely but need rollback playbook.
alex: rollback plan: revert schema flag and keep old reader path for 48h. But it's painful. I'd prefer to avoid rollback.
maria: suggestion: move migration + brief quiesce to 21:10 UTC (10m delay) and add a deploybot pin so subsequent waves don't start earlier. That gives index job time to finish to ~85% and pause point.
sre_jordan: we have deploybot command: `/deploybot lease tiebreak --prefer migration --reason "hotfix custA"` — that'll force handoff if both request lease simultaneously. Anyone object?
kim_db: objection: only if we also set an escape hatch. If tiebreaker forces migration and it aborts mid-swap, we need immediate rollback path and DB dev on-call.
alex: agreed. I'll add rollback hatches + page kim_db and db oncall before issuing.
maria: also we should pin the service version that reads the new schema to v2.4.3-canary so we don't prematurely route traffic.
sre_jordan: ack. I'll create a short release note snippet and add a canary pin in deploy config.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: lease tiebreak request received. requestor=alex, migration=tenant_id-type-change v3, prefer=migration, reason="hotfix custA", dry_run=false.
alex: performing `/deploybot lease tiebreak --confirm` now.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Lease tiebreak executed. New lease owner: migration(tenant_id-type-change v3) lease_id=lb-8f3e, prev_holder=idx-shadow-472. TTL resets to 900s. Audit: https://deploylog/redwood/leases/1712349998
maria: great — index job noticed and will checkpoint. Kicking off a graceful pause signal.
idx-worker: idx-shadow-472: checkpointed at 60% and paused gracefully. ETA resume cost ~12m to finish.
kim_db: DB oncall pinged and standing by. I pushed the rollback playbook to the runbook channel and annotated the migration with the escape hatch steps.
sre_jordan: adding a temporary routing pin: service-readers -> v2.4.3-canary for 60m, then auto-relax if no regressions.
alex: start migration when ready. I'll monitor latency/rowlock metrics.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Starting migration task: tenant_id-type-change v3. Logs: https://deploylog/redwood/migrations/1712349998/run1
maria: can confirm the quiesce command executed: `SELECT pg_advisory_lock(987654321)` then background backfill starting.
kim_db: watching for long-running transactions. Not seeing new row locks beyond 3s. Good.
alex: seeing a small spike in write latency to 180ms, that's expected in quiesce window. No customer-facing errors yet.
sre_jordan: alert rule watching token: db.lock_waits > 5s for >2m — I'll stand by to abort if triggered.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: migration progress 30% — KV backfills ongoing.
maria: index worker resumed, now at 78% and will finish in ~9m. Good overlap.
kim_db: migration progress 70% and preparing PK swap. This is the most fragile step.
alex: confirming feature flag is off for rollout. If PK swap fails, our rollback is to revert column rename and serve old column under compatibility shim.
maria: index finished. idx-shadow-472 completed and released its lease.
sre_jordan: I see full release of cross-shard token. No further collisions.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: migration completed successfully. PK swap applied. lease lb-8f3e released. Audit: https://deploylog/redwood/migrations/1712349998/success
alex: nice work. I'll update release notes: "tenant_id type change deployed with minimal quiesce; rollback hatch prepared but not used."
kim_db: reminder: follow up with a post-mortem note about tiebreak procedure and consider automating a short-stagger policy for index vs migration jobs.
sre_jordan: filing a small infra task to implement automatic 10m staggering for conflicting leases in same shard-group.
maria: filing a CI job to detect potential shadow-index collisions during migration schedule.
alex: thanks team. :tada:
deploy-bot: Deploybot: Closing thread for migration 1712349998.
